    PowerSystems.Storage Formulations

    Valid DeviceModels for subtypes of Storage include the following:

    Valid DeviceModelDevice TypeFormulation
    DeviceModel(BatteryEMS, BatteryAncillaryServices)BatteryEMSBatteryAncillaryServices
    DeviceModel(GenericBattery, BatteryAncillaryServices)GenericBatteryBatteryAncillaryServices
    DeviceModel(BatteryEMS, BookKeeping)BatteryEMSBookKeeping
    DeviceModel(GenericBattery, BookKeeping)GenericBatteryBookKeeping
    DeviceModel(BatteryEMS, EnergyTarget)BatteryEMSEnergyTarget
    DeviceModel(GenericBattery, EnergyTarget)GenericBatteryEnergyTarget

    BookKeeping

    PowerSimulations.BookKeeping — Type

    Formulation type to add basic storage formulation. With attributes=Dict("reservation"=>true) the formulation is augmented with abinary variable to prevent simultanious charging and discharging

    BookKeeping()

    defined at /home/runner/work/PowerSimulations.jl/PowerSimulations.jl/src/core/formulations.jl:143.

    source

    Variables:

    • ActivePowerInVariable:
      • Bounds: [0.0, ]
      • Default initial value: -1 * PowerSystems.get_active_power(device)
    • ActivePowerOutVariable:
      • Bounds: [0.0, ]
      • Default initial value: PowerSystems.get_active_power(device)
    • ReactivePowerVariable:
      • Bounds: [0.0, ]
      • Default initial value: PowerSystems.get_reactive_power(device)
    • EnergyVariable:
      • Bounds: [0.0, ]
      • Default initial value: PowerSystems.get_initial_storage(device)
    • ReservationVariable:
      • only included if DeviceModel(HydroPumpedStorage, HydroDispatchPumpedStorage; attributes = Dict(reservation => true))
      • Bounds: {0, 1}
      • Default initial value: 1

    Static Parameters:

    • $Pg^\text{min}$ = PowerSystems.get_active_power_limits(device).min
    • $Qg^\text{min}$ = PowerSystems.get_reactive_power_limits(device).min
    • $Qg^\text{max}$ = PowerSystems.get_reactive_power_limits(device).max
    • $E^\text{max}$ = PowerSystems.get_storage_capacity(device)

    Objective:

    Creates an objective function term based on the VariableCost Options where the quantity term is defined as $Pg_t$.

    Expressions:

    Adds $Pg$ and $Qg$ terms to the respective active and reactive power balance expressions created by the selected Network Formulations

    Constraints:

    \[\begin{aligned} & E_{t+1} = E_t + (Pg^{in}_t - Pg^{out}_t) \cdot \Delta T \\ & Pg^{in}_t - r * Pg^\text{in, max} \le Pg^\text{in, max} \\ & Pg^{out}_t + r * Pg^\text{out, max} \le Pg^\text{out, max} \\ & Qg^\text{min} \le Qg_t \le Qg^\text{max} \\ & E_t \le E^\text{max} \end{aligned}\]

    EnergyTarget

    PowerSimulations.EnergyTarget — Type

    Formulation type to add storage formulation that respects end of horizon energy state of charge target. With attributes=Dict("reservation"=>true) the formulation is augmented with abinary variable to prevent simultanious charging and discharging

    EnergyTarget()

    defined at /home/runner/work/PowerSimulations.jl/PowerSimulations.jl/src/core/formulations.jl:153.

    source

    Variables:

    • ActivePowerInVariable:
      • Bounds: [0.0, ]
      • Default initial value: -1 * PowerSystems.get_active_power(device)
    • ActivePowerOutVariable:
      • Bounds: [0.0, ]
      • Default initial value: PowerSystems.get_active_power(device)
    • ReactivePowerVariable:
      • Bounds: [0.0, ]
      • Default initial value: PowerSystems.get_reactive_power(device)
    • EnergyVariable:
      • Bounds: [0.0, ]
      • Default initial value: PowerSystems.get_initial_storage(device)
    • EnergyShortageVariable:
      • Bounds: [ , 0.0]
      • Default initial value: 0.0
    • EnergySurplusVariable:
      • Bounds: [0.0, ]
      • Default initial value: 0.0
    • ReservationVariable:
      • only included if DeviceModel(HydroPumpedStorage, HydroDispatchPumpedStorage; attributes = Dict(reservation => true))
      • Bounds: {0, 1}
      • Default initial value: 1

    Static Parameters:

    • $Pg^\text{min}$ = PowerSystems.get_active_power_limits(device).min
    • $Qg^\text{min}$ = PowerSystems.get_reactive_power_limits(device).min
    • $Qg^\text{max}$ = PowerSystems.get_reactive_power_limits(device).max
    • $E^\text{max}$ = PowerSystems.get_storage_capacity(device)

    Time Series Parameters:

    ParameterDefault Time Series Name
    EnergyTargetTimeSeriesParameterstorage_target

    Objective:

    Creates an objective function term based on the VariableCost Options where the quantity term is defined as $Pg_t$, and objective function terms for StorageManagementCost.

    Expressions:

    Adds $Pg$ and $Qg$ terms to the respective active and reactive power balance expressions created by the selected Network Formulations

    Constraints:

    \[\begin{aligned} & E_{t+1} = E_t + (Pg^{in}_t - Pg^{out}_t) \cdot \Delta T \\ & E_t - E^{surplus}_t + E^{shortage}_t = EnergyTargetTimeSeriesParameter_t \\ & Pg^{in}_t - r * Pg^\text{in, max} \le Pg^\text{in, max} \\ & Pg^{out}_t + r * Pg^\text{out, max} \le Pg^\text{out, max} \\ & Qg^\text{min} \le Qg_t \le Qg^\text{max}\\ & E_t \le E^\text{max} \end{aligned}\]
